parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Admin UI page id (overview | channels | sync | policy pages)

200.description: SDK AdminUiResponse envelope: { page: AdminPage (title + widgets: WidgetCard/WidgetDataTable/WidgetText with data_endpoint routes), status: "ok" } - see sentin8::rfw::page::AdminPage / sentin8::rfw::widget::RemoteWidget; policy pages reuse the shared Shield policy-studio definitions under the hotel8:distrib domain

AdminUiAction.description: An action button shown in the page header.

endpoint.description: Endpoint to POST to (for submit actions).

icon.description: Material Icons code point (hex string) for the button.

route.description: Route to navigate to (for link actions).

AdminUiActionType.description: The kind of a header action button.

AdminUiPage.description: A complete admin UI page definition returned by `GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}`.

actions.description: Optional actions shown in the page header (buttons).

title.description: The page title (shown in breadcrumb and header).

oneOf.description: Redirect to this route (e.g. after a successful form submission).
An error occurred (validation error, server error, etc.).

AdminUiResponse.description:
The response from an admin UI endpoint.

- `GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(page_def)`
- `POST /v1/admin/{resource}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(updated_page_def)` or `AdminUiResponse::Redirect(route)`

AriPushRequest.description:
Body of the ARI push (`start_date`/`end_date` accepted for API compat -
the push uses a rolling 30-day window).

property_id.description: Scopes the push to one property (required for the PMS fetch).

ChannelAriLine.description: One ARI line of the channel availability read (PMS projection passthrough).

ChannelContentRoomType.description: One room type of the channel content read (PMS projection passthrough).

ChannelList.description: Wrapper list returned by the channels endpoint.

property_code.description: Raw property_code path segment (parsed to `property_id` when valid).

ChannelPropertyList.description: Wrapper list returned by the mapped-properties endpoint.

ChannelPropertyMapped.description: Mapped channel-property row (the upsert RETURNING projection).

ChannelPropertyRow.description: One row of the mapped-properties list (NUMERIC markups as text).

ChannelReservationDelivered.description: Reservation-delivery result (booking bound to the PMS reservation).

ChannelRow.description: One row of the channels list.

ChannelSellableProperty.description: One sellable property of a channel.

ChannelUpdated.description: Updated channel row (no `property_id` - the query projection).

ContainerDirection.description: Layout direction for a container's children.

ContentPushRequest.description: Content push request (property is optional - omit for all mapped).

FieldCondition.description: A visibility condition for a form field.

equals.description: The value that must match for this field to be visible.

field.description: The key of the field whose value to check.
The form field key the error refers to.

message.description: The validation message shown under the field.

FormFieldOption.description: One choice of a select-type form field.

FormFieldType.description: Input widget type for a form field.

FormFieldValidation.description: Validation constraints for a form field.

custom_message.description: Message overriding the default validation error.

pattern.description: Regex pattern the value must match.

FormMethod.description: HTTP method used for form submission.

HealthDetail.description: `GET /v1/health` - liveness + build info (no pool probe on this service).

PolicySetDetail.description: One policy set in the detail view (adds the full policy text).

enabled.description: Whether the set participates in evaluation.

policies.description: The full policy text (Shield policy language).

schema.description: Optional schema text bound to the set.

mode.description: The evaluation mode after the mutation.

PolicySetRow.description: One policy set in the list view (the RFW row shape).

enabled.description: Whether the set participates in evaluation.

id.description: The set name; doubles as the RFW row id.

policies_len.description: Number of policy statements in the set.

PolicyTestOutcome.description: A dry-run (test) outcome; nothing was stored.

policy_set_name.description: The set name the candidate text was compiled under.

would_deny.description: Whether the shadow evaluation would deny.

PrincipalAttr.description: One principal attribute in the list view.

attr_value.description: The attribute value (free-form JSON by contract).

PropertyControlsRequest.description: Body of the property-controls PUT (all fields optional - partial update).

PushAck.description: Content/controls push acknowledgement (shared by both push endpoints).

RateMarkupRequest.description: Body of the rate markup/markdown PUT.

RatePlanMapped.description: Rate-plan mapping result (the upsert RETURNING projection).

RelationRecordRow.description: One relation tuple in the list view.

children.description:
Child widgets.

collection back into [`RemoteWidget`]'s manual `ToSchema::schemas` -
recursion terminates at the `$ref` (see the RemoteWidget schema impl).

data_endpoint.description:

row_link.description: Optional row click action - navigates to this route with `{row.id}` substitution.

submit_endpoint.description:
